title.en: lord mayor's show through the city of london.
title.de: lord mayor's show durch die city of london.
title.tr: city of london'da lord mayor's show.

line.en: the lord mayor's parade winds through the city on saturday morning, free to watch. arrive early for a place on the route and expect security checks and crowds.
line.de: die parade des lord mayor zieht am samstagvormittag durch die city, kostenlos zu sehen. früh kommen für einen platz an der strecke; mit sicherheitskontrollen und viel gedränge rechnen.
line.tr: lord mayor geçit töreni cumartesi sabahı şehirden geçiyor, izlemesi ücretsiz. güzergâhta yer için erken git; güvenlik kontrolü ve kalabalık olacak.

sparks.why: Lord Mayor's Show, Sat 14 Nov 2026, procession from Mansion House at 11:00, free to watch (City of London timetable; Londonist weekend guide as a cross-check).
